page.layout: One page of text, main column centred; running head and page number above the column; a sliver of the facing page at the right edge with faint show-through and no legible notes. No marginal notes in a readable block. Digitiser's caption at the foot is not transcribed.

main_text.p: men aliquando manifestis indiciis deprehensi: ad ignicu- lum Rationis, afflictum illum quidem; eluctantem tamen ex intervallo & irradiantem clarius, detecta perfidia: tum etiam ad judices delati, acerrimos habent propugnatores. Boni duces videntur vanis quibusdam & prurientibus ingeniis, quod interdum sine offensa seducant longius: suspenso gradu ductum obscuri, præstolantur eventum; at eventus ille, non nisi scrobs aut obex: interea micant ancipiti spe, & ipsâ periculi trepidatione gestiunt. Quosdam longa majorum duces hos sequentium caterva, patronos

page.notes: The running head and page number are printed at the head of the column. The facing page at the right edge is cropped and shows only show-through; nothing there was transcribed. Hyphenated line ends (indicii-, ignicu-, obse-, Quof-) are joined as printed-hyphen words where the word is continued on the next line; the words "ignicu-lum", "obse-curi" and "sine offensa" were read from the scan with care.
